# Ensure all tables render inline at 10pt body font size without horizontal overflow or float page isolation,
# and replace em/en-dashes with plain hyphens (-).
sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  text <- as.character(arg0_text)
  if (length(text) == 0 || is.na(text) || !nzchar(text)) return("")
  text <- gsub("`", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  parts <- strsplit(text, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  out_parts <- character(length(parts))
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
      out_parts[i] <- "$"
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "^2", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      out_parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)&", "\\\\&", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)_", "\\\\_", p, perl = TRUE)
      if (isTRUE(arg1_in_table)) {
        p <- gsub("\\_", "\\_\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("/", "/\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        # Keep thousands-separated numbers and BC/AD dates on a single line inside table cells
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("([0-9])\\s*(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
        # Prevent line breaks immediately after a leading negative sign (e.g. -10000)
        p <- gsub("(^|\\s|\\()-([0-9])", "\\1\\\\mbox{-}\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
      }
      out_parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(out_parts, collapse = ""))
}

sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex <- function (arg0_line) {
  line_str <- as.character(arg0_line)
  if (length(line_str) == 0 || is.na(line_str) || !nzchar(line_str)) return(line_str)
  parts <- strsplit(line_str, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", " \\approx ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub(
        "\\b(Figures?|Figs?\\.|Tables?|Tabs?\\.|Images?|Definitions?|Sections?|Appendix)(?:\\s+|~)\\\\ref\\{([^}]+)\\}",
        "\\\\crdxref{\\1}{\\2}",
        p,
        perl = TRUE
      )
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", "~", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(parts, collapse = ""))
}

orig_render_figure_template <- render_figure_template
render_figure_template <- function (arg0_file_path, arg1_options = NULL) {
  options <- if (!is.null(arg1_options)) arg1_options else list()
  options$placement <- "!htbp"
  if (is.null(options$max_height) || identical(options$max_height, "none")) {
    options$max_height <- "0.42\\textheight"
  }
  return(orig_render_figure_template(arg0_file_path, options))
}

```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
gaz_map <- jsonlite::fromJSON(GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE, simplifyVector = FALSE)
settlements_list <- unname(gaz_map)

# Sort chronologically by first occupied year, then alphabetically by name
first_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(99999)
  return(min(yrs))
}
last_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(-99999)
  return(max(yrs))
}

ord_idx <- order(
  vapply(settlements_list, first_year_num, numeric(1)),
  vapply(settlements_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1))
)
settlements_list <- settlements_list[ord_idx]

translit_cyr <- function (arg0_str) {
  s <- as.character(arg0_str)
  if (!nzchar(s)) return("")
  # Map Cyrillic characters to Latin so Karla 10pt renders every character cleanly in XeLaTeX
  cyr <- c(
    "А","Б","В","Г","Д","Е","Ё","Ж","З","И","Й","К","Л","М","Н","О","П","Р","С","Т","У","Ф","Х","Ц","Ч","Ш","Щ","Ъ","Ы","Ь","Э","Ю","Я",
    "а","б","в","г","д","е","ё","ж","з","и","й","к","л","м","н","о","п","р","с","т","у","ф","х","ц","ч","ш","щ","ъ","ы","ь","э","ю","я",
    "Φ","α","ν","γ","ό","ρ","ε","ι","Κ","ῆ","π","ο","Πα","τ","ύ","ς","Τ","ά","ϊ","μ","β","η","К"
  )
  lat <- c(
    "A","B","V","G","D","E","Yo","Zh","Z","I","Y","K","L","M","N","O","P","R","S","T","U","F","Kh","Ts","Ch","Sh","Shch","","Y","","E","Yu","Ya",
    "a","b","v","g","d","e","yo","zh","z","i","y","k","l","m","n","o","p","r","s","t","u","f","kh","ts","ch","sh","shch","","y","","e","yu","ya",
    "Ph","a","n","g","o","r","e","i","K","e","p","o","Pa","t","y","s","T","a","i","m","b","e","K"
  )
  for (i in seq_along(cyr)) {
    s <- gsub(cyr[i], lat[i], s, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  return(s)
}

fmt_other_names <- function (arg0_s) {
  onames <- unlist(arg0_s$other_names)
  if (length(onames) == 0) return("-")
  clean_vec <- unique(vapply(onames, translit_cyr, character(1)))
  clean_vec <- clean_vec[nzchar(clean_vec) & tolower(clean_vec) != tolower(arg0_s$name)]
  if (length(clean_vec) == 0) {
    clean_vec <- unique(vapply(onames, translit_cyr, character(1)))
  }
  return(paste(head(clean_vec, 2L), collapse = "; "))
}

fmt_year_lbl <- function (arg0_y) {
  y <- as.numeric(arg0_y)
  if (y < 0) return(paste0(abs(round(y)), "BC"))
  return(paste0(round(y), "AD"))
}

fmt_span <- function (arg0_s) {
  y1 <- first_year_num(arg0_s)
  y2 <- last_year_num(arg0_s)
  if (y1 == y2) return(fmt_year_lbl(y1))
  if (y1 < 0 && y2 < 0) return(paste0(abs(y1), "-", abs(y2), "BC"))
  if (y1 > 0 && y2 > 0) return(paste0(y1, "-", y2, "AD"))
  return(paste0(fmt_year_lbl(y1), " - ", fmt_year_lbl(y2)))
}

fmt_num_eu <- function (arg0_val) {
  if (is.null(arg0_val) || is.na(arg0_val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(arg0_val)
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000000.0, format = "f", digits = 2L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000.0, format = "f", digits = 1L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

fmt_coord_pair <- function (arg0_coords) {
  lat <- gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(arg0_coords[[1]])))
  lon <- gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(arg0_coords[[2]])))
  return(paste0(lat, "°N, ", lon, "°E"))
}

fmt_pop_series <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin = -99999, arg2_ymax = 99999) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  parts <- vapply(keep, function (idx) {
    paste0(fmt_year_lbl(yrs[idx]), ": ", fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
  }, character(1))
  return(paste(parts, collapse = "; "))
}

get_pop_window_val <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin, arg2_ymax) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  # Take the latest year in the window
  idx <- keep[which.max(yrs[keep])]
  return(fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
}
```

# Abstract

Across the 165k km² of the Russian Pontic Steppe, towns and villages clustered along the Lower Don, the Azov coast and the Taman Peninsula while the inland Sal-Manych and Don-Donets watersheds shifted from nomadic grazing lands to Cossack and peasant farming districts after 1700AD. Early riverine fishing villages at Rakushechny Yar (50-120 residents in 6000-5000BC) [@belanovskaya1995rakushechnyy; @tsybrij2018rakushechnyy] and Late Bronze Age Srubnaya and Kobyakovo settlements [@sharafutdinova1980kobyakovo; @potapov2013krest] were followed in the Classical and Roman eras by the Bosporan Greek cities of Phanagoria (12,5k in 350BC), Gorgippia (7,5k), Hermonassa (5,5k) and Kepoi (3,8k) on Taman [@paromov1992karta; @kuznetsov2010phanagoria; @garbuzov2013selskaya] and the delta emporia of Elizavetovskoye (3,8k) and Tanais (4k in 150AD) with its ten Maeotian forts [@marchenko2000elizavetovskoye; @vdovchenkov2019meotov]. In the Middle Ages, the Khazar fortresses of Sarkel (3,2k in 900AD), Semikarakorskoye (2,8k) and Tamatarkha (10k) anchored the Saltovo-Mayaki village network [@artamonov1958sarkel; @afanasyev1993donskiye], and under the Golden Horde the port of Azak/Tana reached 54k inhabitants in 1340AD before falling to 13k on the eve of Timur's 1395 sack [@maslovsky2024chislennosti]. From the 16th century, Don Cossack island *gorodki* at Razdory and Cherkassk (7,5k in 1700AD) and 18th- and 19th-century port, railway and coal towns transformed the region, led in 1897 by Rostov-on-Don and Nakhichevan-on-Don (147,9k combined), Novocherkassk (52k), Taganrog (51,4k), Yeysk (35,4k) and Azov (27,5k) [@mininkov1998donskoye; @troynitsky1905don; @troynitsky1905kuban; @volvenko2023priazovya].

# Methodology

This gazetteer compiles 176 settlements across the Russian Pontic Steppe from 10000BC to 1900AD, recording historical and alternative names, geographic coordinates and benchmark population estimates.

Population figures are derived from excavated dwelling floor areas and settlement plans for prehistoric and Bronze Age sites [@belanovskaya1995rakushechnyy; @tsybrij2018rakushechnyy; @dolbunova2021rakovinnyye; @skorobogatov2025keramicheskiy; @potapov2013krest; @sharafutdinova1980kobyakovo], walled urban areas and rural surveys for Classical Bosporan, Maeotian and Sarmatian settlements [@paromov1992karta; @kuznetsov2010phanagoria; @garbuzov2011osvoyeniye; @garbuzov2013selskaya; @marchenko2000elizavetovskoye; @kopylov2016vremeni; @batieva2011naseleniye; @vdovchenkov2019meotov], fortress and urban excavations for Khazar Saltovo-Mayaki and Golden Horde cities [@artamonov1958sarkel; @afanasyev1993donskiye; @flyorov2011goroda; @maslovsky2017azak; @maslovsky2022tokhtamysh; @maslovsky2024chislennosti] and Russian *Posolsky Prikaz* rolls, Imperial tax revisions (*revizii*) and the 1897 Census for Don and Kuban Cossack *stanitsas*, peasant *slobodas* and cities [@mininkov1998donskoye; @sushchiy2019institut; @prudnikov2024gorodok; @pronshtein1961zemlya; @kabuzan1976zaseleniye; @agafonov2017zemli; @kolomeytseva2018krestyanstva; @burykina2008osvoyeniye; @parshina2023kubanskogo; @volvenko2023priazovya; @troynitsky1905don; @troynitsky1905kuban].

# Results

## Early Camps, Bronze Age Villages and Classical Cities

```{r tab-pontic-ancient, results='asis'}
ancient_list <- Filter(function (s) first_year_num(s) <= 500, settlements_list)

df_ancient <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ancient_list, function (s) {
  data.frame(
    Settlement = s$name,
    Other_Names = fmt_other_names(s),
    Coords = fmt_coord_pair(s$coords),
    Span = fmt_span(s),
    Pop_History = fmt_pop_series(s, -10000, 500),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

render_table_template(
  df_ancient,
  list(
    caption = "Coordinates, dates of occupation and benchmark populations derived from house-floor areas, walled urban footprints and rural surveys for prehistoric camps, Srubnaya terrace villages, Bosporan Greek colonies and Maeotian-Sarmatian forts.",
    label = "tab:pontic-ancient",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical / Alternative Names", "Coords", "Occupied Span", "Population Estimates by Date"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE
  )
)
```

## Khazar, Rus and Golden Horde Settlements

```{r tab-pontic-medieval, results='asis'}
med_list <- Filter(function (s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(s$population))
  any(yrs >= 650 & yrs <= 1550)
}, settlements_list)

df_med <- do.call(rbind, lapply(med_list, function (s) {
  data.frame(
    Settlement = s$name,
    Other_Names = fmt_other_names(s),
    Coords = fmt_coord_pair(s$coords),
    P_750_850 = get_pop_window_val(s, 750, 850),
    P_900 = get_pop_window_val(s, 880, 920),
    P_1000_1200 = get_pop_window_val(s, 960, 1220),
    P_1340 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1320, 1360),
    P_1380_1500 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1370, 1520),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

render_table_template(
  df_med,
  list(
    caption = "Estimated populations across five medieval benchmark windows for Khazar stone and brick fortresses, Saltovo-Mayaki farming villages, Tmutarakan and Golden Horde Azak (Tana) with its delta hinterland.",
    label = "tab:pontic-medieval",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical Names", "Coords", "750-850AD", "900AD", "1000-1200AD", "1340AD", "1380-1500AD"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE
  )
)
```
